describe: The image shows about ten rectangular steel plates of varying sizes overlapping one another, each with small round rivets along its edges and a rough, hammered grey texture. The plates are dark grey to near-black with lighter grey-silver highlights, and some are a dull brown-grey tint. A few round shiny bolt heads sit on the plate edges. This is a texture sheet of a few large pieces: every plate and rivet must stay exactly in place. Lighting is even with moderate contrast.
